description: Cross-repo retrieval suite. Federated reads ship with no weights and no boosts (only ties break toward the local repo), so a future weighting change has to be justified against these numbers. The cases that matter are not 'does a linked repo's answer come back' -- anyone can make that work -- but 'does the local answer still win on a tie' and 'does a plausible foreign distractor outrank the correct local answer'.

cases.why: The answer lives in a linked repo and must be reachable, while that repo's private auth note must not be, even though it also matches 'auth'. Both properties in one case: the evaluator scores an empty expectedItemIds as a miss, so a pure must-not-return case cannot be expressed here.
Identical content in two repos. Ties break toward the local repo, so the local copy must be the single result.
A plausible foreign item exists. The correct local answer must still rank first.
